content.class.journeyman.blurb: 你是羊毛行会的工匠，行会今晚派你到会堂来帮管事。你带着一盏提灯和晚饭。
content.class.journeyman.kit.0.name: 自带的提灯
content.class.journeyman.name: 熟手
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-bolts.opt.0.label: 我们带过去。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-bolts.text: 两把都转开了，我听见了。好了——契书在库房最里头的箱子里。拿出来给我。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-charter.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-charter.text: 羊毛行会的契书，行会创立时盖了印。上面写明谁可以在马罗比做羊毛买卖。新任会长们明早要对着它宣誓。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-farewell.opt.0.label: 晚安。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-farewell.text: 按规矩办完了。出去时把两把钥匙挂回去，我会守门到天亮。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-hello.opt.0.label: 那就打开吧。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-hello.opt.1.label: 契书是什么？
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-hello.text: 你们就是行会派来的帮手吧。好。天亮前契书得摆在这张桌上，而契书就在我身后那间库房里。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-locks.opt.0.label: 哪把锁是谁的？
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-locks.opt.1.label: 我们这就去。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-locks.text: 东门取守库人的钥匙，西门取书记的钥匙。每把钥匙只能插进我这扇门两侧它自己的那把锁。两把都转开了就告诉我，我来拉门闩。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-open.opt.0.label: 这就去。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-open.text: 库房最里头的箱子。当心门槛。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-ready.opt.0.label: 两把都转好了。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-ready.text: 两声咔嗒。我在门这边都听见了。你说一声，我就拉门闩。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-return.opt.0.label: 在这里。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-return.text: 就是这份契书。封蜡完好。放到这里，桌上。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-rule.opt.0.label: 我们去取两把。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-rule.opt.1.label: 为什么两把钥匙？
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-rule.text: 不能由我来开。那间库房有两把锁、两把钥匙。守库人的钥匙是一把沉甸甸的铁钥匙，挂在东门里账房的钩子上。书记的钥匙是一把发黑的老钥匙，放在西门里档案室的盒子里。守门的人一把钥匙也不能拿。这就是规矩，我守了二十二年。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-which.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-which.text: 守库人的锁在门东侧，账房那边。书记的锁在西侧，档案室那边。一把锁不认另一把钥匙。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-why.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-why.text: 这样就没有哪一双手能独自打开它。一把钥匙只转自己的锁，每把锁都要人拿着对应的钥匙亲手去转。
content.fx.the-charter.oc.take-the-clerk-key.1.n: 书记的钥匙从盒子里取出，旧得发黑。
守库人的钥匙从钩子上取下，又沉又凉。
书记的锁咔嗒一声，沉沉转开。库房门仍然紧闭。
content.fx.the-charter.oc.turn-the-warden-lock.1: 守库人的锁咔嗒一声，沉沉转开。库房门仍然紧闭。
content.npc.hesketh.name: 赫斯基斯·马尔
content.obj.the-charter.bring-the-charter.hint: 把它带出来，交给库房门边的赫斯基斯·马尔。
content.obj.the-charter.bring-the-charter.title: 把契书交给管事
content.obj.the-charter.meet-the-steward.hint: 赫斯基斯·马尔守着会堂北端的库房门。
content.obj.the-charter.meet-the-steward.title: 去见管事
content.obj.the-charter.open-the-strongroom.hint: 两把锁都已转开。赫斯基斯·马尔就在库房门边。
content.obj.the-charter.take-the-charter.hint: 在库房最里头的箱子里。
content.obj.the-charter.take-the-charter.title: 取出契书
content.obj.the-charter.take-the-clerk-key.hint: 西侧门内，档案室的盒子里。
content.obj.the-charter.take-the-clerk-key.title: 取书记的钥匙
content.obj.the-charter.take-the-warden-key.hint: 东侧门内，账房的钩子上。
content.obj.the-charter.turn-the-clerk-lock.hint: 握着书记的钥匙，去库房门西侧的锁。
content.obj.the-charter.turn-the-clerk-lock.miss: 书记的锁只认一把钥匙，而那把钥匙不在你手上。
content.obj.the-charter.turn-the-warden-lock.hin: 握着守库人的钥匙，去库房门东侧的锁。
content.obj.the-charter.turn-the-warden-lock.mis: 守库人的锁只认一把钥匙，而那把钥匙不在你手上。
content.quest.the-charter.goal: 从账房取来守库人的钥匙，从档案室取来书记的钥匙，在库房门两侧各自的锁上转开，再把契书拿出来交给管事。
content.world.outro: 契书已放在管事的桌上，等新任会长天亮来取。两把钥匙都挂回了原处，一东一西，隔着整座大厅。
content.world.title: 两把钥匙

source.class.journeyman.blurb: You are a journeyman of the Staple, sent up to the hall tonight to help the steward. You carry a lantern and your supper.
source.class.journeyman.kit.0.name: Your own lantern
source.class.journeyman.name: Journeyman
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-bolts.opt.0.label: We'll bring it.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-bolts.text: Both. I heard them. There. The charter is in the chest at the back of the room. Bring it out to me.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-charter.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-charter.text: The Staple's deed, sealed when the guild was young. It says who may trade wool at Marrowby. The new masters swear on it in the morning.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-farewell.opt.0.label: Good night.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-farewell.text: Done by the rule. Hang the keys back on your way out, and I'll keep the door till morning.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-hello.opt.0.label: Then let's open it.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-hello.opt.1.label: What is the charter?
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-hello.text: You'll be the help the guild sent up. Good. The charter has to be on this table by dawn, and the charter is in the room behind me.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-locks.opt.0.label: Which lock is whose?
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-locks.opt.1.label: We're going.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-locks.text: East door for the Warden's key, west door for the Clerk's. Each turns in its own lock, either side of this door. When both are turned, tell me, and I'll draw the bolts.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-open.opt.0.label: Going.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-open.text: The chest at the back of the room. Mind the step.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-ready.opt.0.label: Both are turned.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-ready.text: Two clicks. I heard them both through the door. Say the word and I'll draw the bolts.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-return.opt.0.label: Here it is.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-return.text: That's the deed. The seal's whole. Put it here, on the table.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-rule.opt.0.label: We'll fetch both.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-rule.opt.1.label: Why two keys?
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-rule.text: Not by me. The room has two locks and two keys. The Warden's key is a heavy iron key on a hook in the counting room, through the east door. The Clerk's key is a dark old key in a box in the archive, through the west door. The one who keeps the door holds no key. That is the rule, and I have kept it twenty-two years.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-which.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-which.text: The Warden's lock is east of the door, on the counting-room side. The Clerk's is west, on the archive side. A lock will not take the other key.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-why.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.hesketh.hesketh-why.text: So no one pair of hands can open it alone. A key turns only in its own lock, and each lock wants its key held in the hand that turns it.
source.fx.the-charter.oc.take-the-clerk-key.1.n: The Clerk's key lifts out of its box, dark with age.
The Warden's key comes off its hook, heavy and cold.
The Clerk's lock turns with a heavy click. The strongroom door holds.
source.fx.the-charter.oc.turn-the-warden-lock.1: The Warden's lock turns with a heavy click. The strongroom door holds.
source.npc.hesketh.name: Hesketh Marr
source.obj.the-charter.bring-the-charter.hint: Carry it out to Hesketh, by the strongroom door.
source.obj.the-charter.bring-the-charter.title: Bring the charter to the steward
source.obj.the-charter.meet-the-steward.hint: Hesketh Marr keeps the strongroom door, at the north end of the hall.
source.obj.the-charter.meet-the-steward.title: Meet the steward
source.obj.the-charter.open-the-strongroom.hint: Both locks are turned. Hesketh is by the strongroom door.
source.obj.the-charter.take-the-charter.hint: In the chest at the back of the strongroom.
source.obj.the-charter.take-the-charter.title: Take the charter
source.obj.the-charter.take-the-clerk-key.hint: Through the west door, in its box in the archive.
source.obj.the-charter.take-the-clerk-key.title: Take the Clerk's key
source.obj.the-charter.take-the-warden-key.hint: Through the east door, on its hook in the counting room.
source.obj.the-charter.turn-the-clerk-lock.hint: Hold the Clerk's key at the lock west of the strongroom door.
source.obj.the-charter.turn-the-clerk-lock.miss: The Clerk's lock is cut for one key, and that key is not in your hand.
source.obj.the-charter.turn-the-warden-lock.hin: Hold the Warden's key at the lock east of the strongroom door.
source.obj.the-charter.turn-the-warden-lock.mis: The Warden's lock is cut for one key, and that key is not in your hand.
source.quest.the-charter.goal: Fetch the Warden's key from the counting room and the Clerk's key from the archive, turn each in its own lock beside the strongroom door, and bring the charter out to the steward.
source.world.outro: The charter lies on the steward's table, ready for the new masters at dawn. Both keys are back on their hooks, a hall apart.
source.world.title: Two Keys
